rules.statement: V told Saul that Panam and the veterans planned to steal a Militech Basilisk convoy behind his back. Saul learned the plan from V.
V accepted Panam's invitation to share an intimate experience through the Basilisk's sensory link, and the two became lovers.
V explained to Panam that a biochip and the personality construct inside it are harming V and threatening V's life. Panam knows this is why V is trying to survive.
V helped free Saul from the Raffen Shiv. The rescue and escape through the storm were completed, and Saul survived to shelter at the farmhouse.
Saul and Panam formally welcomed V into the Aldecaldos. V received the clan jacket as a member of the family before the assault.
During the Aldecaldo assault inside Arasaka, Adam Smasher killed Saul in front of V and Panam. Panam witnessed Saul's death.
Dakota's Flying Drugs contract was completed: the interference antenna was disabled, clearing the obstruction to the smuggling drones.
V completed Dakota's Dancing on a Minefield job and delivered the recovered vehicle from the minefield.
Trevor's remains were recovered and handed over through Dakota's arranged transport, completing Trevor's Last Ride.
The requested training software was delivered for Dakota's Sparring Partner contract.
Iris Tanner was rescued for Dakota's No Fixers contract, and Iris's van was delivered as well.
Benedict McAdams was extracted and delivered to his nomad contact, completing Dakota's MIA contract.
Bruce was rescued from the detention camp and handed over to Archibald, completing Dakota's Goodbye, Night City contract.
The mobile Militech radar prototype was brought to Dakota's workshop, and the Radar Love contract was completed.
The Militech convoy operation brought a Basilisk back to the Aldecaldo camp. Panam presented it to Saul and the clan kept it for assembly.
After the camp was saved, Saul announced that Panam would lead the Aldecaldo family alongside him. Panam became his co-leader.
